basis: Complex spastic paraplegia; muscle atrophy and structural skeletal abnormalities are frequent (30-79%), with kyphoscoliosis in 2/2.
Inherited dopamine-metabolism disorder causing dystonia; hearing impairment annotated 30-79%. Dystonic foot postures alone do not establish structural skeletal damage.
Meningeal tumor; radiation identifies its cause, not an additional affected organ.
Defined by congenital cardiac malposition. Mirror-image abdominal organs do not imply damage; associated heart defects and ciliary disease affect a minority.
Epileptic neurodevelopmental disorder; contractures/scoliosis 3/3, sensorineural hearing loss 2/2, cataract 1/3. Cerebral visual impairment belongs to neurologic.
Purely psychiatric mood disorder; no qualifying organ axis.
Nonsyndromic intellectual developmental disorder; intellectual disability in 3/3.
Acute bile duct inflammation, typically caused by ascending bacterial infection.
Mitochondrial encephalopathy with defining neonatal respiratory failure; cardiomyopathy 8/15 (~53%). Brittle hair 6/11 omitted by cap; hepatomegaly alone is insufficient.
Clonal plasma-cell protein-deposition disorder; cardiac dysfunction 80-99%, renal dysfunction 30-79%. Hepatic, neural, GI and pulmonary findings omitted by cap.
Motor-neuron disorder with intellectual disability; denervation causes defining skeletal-muscle wasting in most affected patients.
Congenital structural defect of the oral palate. Hearing impairment and otitis media are occasional (5-29%).
Inherited retinal dystrophy; disease is defined by retinal involvement.
Paraneoplastic peripheral nerve injury, generally mediated by an immune response to the distant tumor.
GDI1-related nonsyndromic intellectual disability; neurologic dysfunction defines the disorder.
UV-sensitive skin DNA-repair disorder; cataract 1/1 and microphthalmia 1/3 support ocular damage; developmental delay/microcephaly 1/3 support neurologic involvement.
Pseudomonas infection directly damages lung parenchyma, causing pneumonia with hemorrhage and necrosis.
Optic nerve hypoplasia 11/12, scoliosis 5/5 and contractures 2/2, hearing impairment 4/5. Precocious puberty 5/5 omitted by cap; respiratory findings lack proven lung injury.
Defined by multiple congenital joint contractures. Neurologic causes occur in some subtypes but are not universal across the umbrella.
Tumor originates in the colon; liver metastases directly occupy hepatic tissue in roughly 60-70% of metastatic cases. Lung involvement is less consistently >=30%.
Inherited platelet disorder with anemia and marrow fibrosis; associated splenomegaly remains within the haematologic axis.
Developmental delay 2/2; alopecia/erythroderma 1/1 and nail dystrophy 1/2; bronchiectasis 1/2. Hearing loss and enamel hypoplasia, each 1/2, omitted by cap.
Predominant phenotype is hypomyelinating leukodystrophy. Dental, endocrine and progeroid abnormalities vary across subtypes; umbrella-wide frequencies are uncertain.
Major phenotypes share brain abnormalities or neurodegeneration. Dysosteosclerosis belongs to the uncommon recessive subtype, not most patients across the umbrella.
Inherited dystrophy of the retinal macula.
